title: Oceanic Brazilian Shrimp Ceviche
description: A refreshing and festive Brazilian dish featuring shrimp marinated in a zesty mixture of mayonnaise and spices, served in a ramekin.
instructions: Rinse the shrimp under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, lime juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped cilantro, red onion, and minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the shrimp to marinate.
Just before serving, give the shrimp a good stir and spoon them into small ramekins.
Serve the ceviche chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Discard any leftover ceviche after 24 hours.
